risks.risk: Disc inclusion and working condition are unknown (could be missing discs, dead discs, or untested).
risks.proof: A short video showing each box opened with the disc(s) clearly visible, plus a quick PS5/PS4 test screen showing the game launching (or at minimum the disc label and no cracks/scratches).
risks.if_unproven: Price as boxed games with unknown disc presence/condition (worst case: not working or missing discs).

risks.risk: Region lock / compatibility mismatch (PS4 vs PS5 versions; some titles may not run on the buyer’s console).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the back cover/region and the exact version text (PS4/PS5) for each title, or a video showing the console recognizing the disc as the correct platform.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed/uncertain compatibility (worst case: some titles not usable on PS5).

risks.risk: Incomplete packaging (missing manuals/inserts) or damaged cases.
risks.proof: Photos of each case front/back and inside (manual/inserts present or absent), and a close-up of any cracks or broken hinges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially incomplete/damaged retail packaging (worst case: damaged or missing inserts).

risks.risk: Title count and exact games are unclear (some labels not fully readable), risking overpaying for fewer/other titles.
risks.proof: A single overhead shot listing all titles clearly (or a spreadsheet-style count photo) with each game name readable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as fewer/uncertain titles (worst case: only the clearly readable ones).

risks.risk: Potential scam/label-only listing (boxes may be present but discs could be swapped or counterfeit).
risks.proof: A clip showing the disc(s) matching the box artwork (disc label matches title) for each item, plus a quick install/launch attempt.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest tier for unverified authenticity/condition (worst case: counterfeit or non-functional).

proof_requests: Open each box and show the disc(s) clearly (disc label/title matches the box).
Show a quick test on a PS5 (or PS4 if applicable) launching at least a couple of the games successfully.
Provide close-ups of the back cover text showing PS4 vs PS5 version and region/compatibility.
Confirm the exact number of titles and list each game name with readable labels (one clear group photo).
Show whether cases are complete (manuals/inserts) and check for cracks/warping.
response.reason: The witness confirms boxed items with PS5/4PS markings and some readable titles, but key pricing drivers (disc inclusion/working condition, exact PS5 vs PS4 compatibility, and exact title count) are not verifiable from the provided report. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
